messages:
mia: Heads up — customers reporting p99 latency spike for sparrow-v2 on long inputs (>10k tokens). Started ~ 11:34 PDT after the tokenizer change landed.

devin: Confirming. p95 looks fine but p99 went from ~920ms -> 2.6s on dedicated infra for long-context requests. Traces point to tokenization + kvcache warm path.

parker: Any 503/500s or auth/billing noise? need to know if this is retry amplification.

mia: No 5xxs. API success rates normal. Just tail latency. A few customers reported perceived timeouts because client-side 2s timeout was hit.

sophie: I pulled the traces. Root cause seems to be an extra normalization pass in tokenizer v2 that was supposed to handle CJK edgecases. For short contexts it's fine, but for long contexts we see repeated regex scans: ~700ms extra for 12-15k tokens.

devin: Repro steps I used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"sparrow-v2","input":"<10k token long doc>"}'
```

Then compare timing with sparrow-v1. v1 median p99 for same input ~900ms.

mia: Ops: can we get a quick mitigation? Customers on dedicated are impacted.

ops-bot: Can run rollback to sparrow-v1 variant for affected customers. Runbook: `ops rollback-model --customer <id> --model sparrow-v1` (requires infra approvals).

parker: Before rollback, try enabling prefix KV caching for sparrow-v2 as hotfix? If KV cache avoided repeated tokenization steps we might reduce tail.

sophie: KV caching helps in some flows, but tokenizer normalization happens pre-tokenization. So it won't reduce the regex scan cost per request. Two alternatives: 1) rollback tokenizer change for sparrow-v2; 2) deploy a trimmed tokenizer config that disables the extra normalization for inputs >8k tokens.

devin: I can push a quick build that gates the normalization by input length (fallback to v1 path for >8k tokens). Build taking ~45m, then can canary to 5%.

mia: Customers with dedicated capacity want urgent fix. I suggest: canary the guarded build, and at the same time offer to roll them to sparrow-v1 if they prefer immediate mitigation.

parker: Agreed. Also add an alert rule to flag p99 delta > 1s for model rollouts so next time we catch earlier.

infra-bot: Canary deployment started by devin — canary id can-7823, target 5% on us-west-2 dedicated pool.

sophie: I'll run a quick perf test on the canary with the long-doc repro. Share results in 30m.

(devin edited message): canary shows p99 down to 1.0s from 2.6s for sample runs, p95 unaffected. Still worse than v1 but acceptable short-term.

mia: Send customer comms offering rollback or opt-in to canary, include ETA ~1.5h for full rollout if canary looks stable.

ops-bot: Rollback request acknowledged for customer 38-Alpha. Started rollback to sparrow-v1 on their pool.

sophie: Follow-up: I'm creating an issue to revert the problematic normalization and add unit tests for long-context tokenization performance. Ticket: PERF-2981.

mia: Thanks — please @devin @parker when the rollout completes. Also capture repro sample and attach to support ticket.

devin: Note for postmortem: we didn't have a model-level long-context perf test in CI for tokenizers. I'll add a 12k-token synthetic test to the onboarding suite.

mia: Closing loop — customers on canary reported improved tail. Dedicated rollback finished for the most impacted customer. Keeping this thread open until PERF-2981 merged and model rollout done.

sophie: Action items:
- devin: push guarded build + canary -> done (can-7823)
- sophie: perf runs + create PERF-2981 -> done
- parker: add alert for p99 delta on rollouts -> in progress
- mia: customer comms + support ticket updates -> in progress

mia: :thumbsup:
